summary: The Node.js server SDK and the Go, Rust, C#, and C++ SDK sources are maintained in the public RandseedSDK repository. The browser-only @randseed/game-sdk is a separate npm package.

node.heading: Node.js SDK (GitHub)
node.installGuidance: Pin a reviewed tag or commit instead of main for reproducible builds.
node.requirements: Target fixed runtime nodejs-22 or nodejs-24 in randseed.fullstack.json and bundle the room server into a single ESM entrypoint for code.tar.gz.
